en_title: Marvel's Wolverine ESRB Rating Promises 'a Handful of Sequences' Featuring 'Exposed Buttocks'
cn_title: 《漫威金刚狼》将短暂露出角色臀部
subtitle: M级尺度拉满？
opus_summary: 《漫威金刚狼》的ESRB评级确认，游戏包含血腥、强烈暴力、粗俗语言和部分裸露内容，其中少数场景会短暂呈现角色裸露的臀部。作品将于2026年9月15日独占登陆PS5，整体风格比Insomniac此前作品更加血腥。

paragraphs.en: Marvel's Wolverine will have gore, intense violence, strong language, and at least a few scenes featuring "a character's exposed buttocks," according to its Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) rating.
paragraphs.cn: 根据娱乐软件分级委员会（ESRB）的评级，《漫威金刚狼》将包含血腥画面、强烈暴力、粗俗语言，以及至少几个呈现「角色裸露臀部」的场景。

paragraphs.en: The full description for Insomniac Games' M-rated superhero experience warned would-be players that "partial nudity" is one of the many elements they'll need to consider before picking up a copy this September (via MP1st ). However, a more specific explanation toward the end of the page suggested the only example of this in the game might be one or two instances of on-screen butts.
paragraphs.cn: Insomniac制作的这款M级超级英雄游戏的完整描述提醒有意购买的玩家，「部分裸露」是他们在今年9月入手游戏前需要考虑的诸多内容之一（据MP1st报道）。不过，页面末尾更具体的说明暗示，游戏中与此相关的内容可能只有一两次在画面中出现臀部。

paragraphs.en: The warning reads as follows: "A handful of sequences briefly depict a character's exposed buttocks."
paragraphs.cn: 警告内容如下：「少数场景会短暂呈现角色裸露的臀部。」

paragraphs.en: The context and character butt in question remains to be seen, but fans may want to prepare for Logan's rear end to be front and center in his own video game. For some reason, this isn't quite uncharted territory for Wolverine.
paragraphs.cn: 具体情境和涉及的角色臀部仍有待揭晓，但粉丝或许可以做好准备，迎接Logan的臀部在自己的游戏中成为视觉中心。不知为何，这对金刚狼来说并不算完全陌生的领域。

paragraphs.en: Disney+ left Hugh Jackman's butt uncensored when X-Men: Days of Future Past came to the streaming service back in 2020. Deadpool & Wolverine then put the focus on Jackman's behind when it came out in 2024 and allegedly nearly doubled down on it by referring to his butt as "Canada's Ass" in one deleted scene .
paragraphs.cn: 2020年《X战警：逆转未来》登陆Disney+时，平台没有对Hugh Jackman的臀部进行删改。2024年上映的《Deadpool & Wolverine》随后又把焦点放在Jackman的臀部上，据称还在一段被删除的场景中称其为「加拿大的屁股」，进一步加码调侃。

paragraphs.en: It's also a shame Marvel's Wolverine will be PlayStation 5 exclusive when it launches next month, as some might remember a few lucky Xbox fans got some…unique controllers a few years back. The Xbox-exclusive "designed by Deadpool" controllers both came suited up in Deadpool & Wolverine's red and yellow superhero suit attire. They also happened to be extremely caked up .
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，《漫威金刚狼》下个月发售时将独占PlayStation 5，因为有些人可能还记得，几年前一些幸运的XBOX粉丝拿到过几款……独特的手柄。这些XBOX独占、由Deadpool设计的手柄都穿上了《Deadpool & Wolverine》中那套红黄相间的超级英雄战衣，碰巧还拥有极其夸张的臀部曲线。

paragraphs.en: The full ESRB description for Marvel's Wolverine can be found here: "Marvel's Wolverine is rated M for Mature 17+ by the ESRB with Blood and Gore, Drug Reference, Intense Violence, Partial Nudity, and Strong Language. Also includes In-Game Purchases. This is an action game in which players assume the role of James Logan/Wolverine, as he reunites with Team X to stop a dangerous threat. From a third-person perspective, players use melee attacks and special skills to kill enemy soldiers and robots in frenetic combat. Players use their claws to slash, stab, and slice enemies; rage modes allow players to enact faster, more destructive combos and slow-motion finishers (e.g., dramatically stabbing an enemy in the head). Combat is highlighted by frequent blood-splatter effects, screams of pain, and dismemberment/decapitation. Battlefields are sometimes strewn with torsos and limbs; cutscenes can also depict blood and gore (e.g., characters tearing enemies apart, decapitating enemy soldiers). A handful of sequences briefly depict a character's exposed buttocks. The dialogue references drugs (e.g., “It doubled my production of fentanyl.”). The words “f**k” and “sh*t” appear in the game."
paragraphs.cn: 《漫威金刚狼》的完整ESRB描述如下：「《漫威金刚狼》获ESRB评为M级，适合17岁以上玩家，包含血腥与暴力、毒品提及、强烈暴力、部分裸露和粗俗语言。游戏还包含内购。玩家将在这款动作游戏中扮演James Logan（金刚狼），与Team X重聚以阻止一项危险威胁。从第三人称视角出发，玩家会在激烈战斗中使用近战攻击和特殊技能杀死敌方士兵与机器人。玩家会用爪子劈砍、刺击和切割敌人；狂暴模式允许玩家施展更快、更具破坏力的连招和慢动作终结技（例如戏剧性地刺穿敌人的头部）。战斗中会频繁出现血液飞溅、痛苦尖叫、肢解和斩首。战场有时散落着躯干和四肢；过场动画也可能呈现血腥暴力内容（例如角色撕碎敌人、斩首敌方士兵）。少数场景会短暂呈现角色裸露的臀部。对话中会提及毒品（例如「这让我的芬太尼产量翻倍了」）。游戏中会出现「f**k」和「sh*t」等词。」

paragraphs.en: We didn't really need the full ESRB description to tell us that Marvel's Wolverine will veer in a new direction for the Marvel's Spider-Man game developers at Insomniac. Pre-release footage for the game has so far promised an especially gory take on the classic comic book X-Men member, with gameplay clips showing that players will be able to rip apart any goon that gets in their way.
paragraphs.cn: 其实，我们并不需要完整的ESRB描述，也能看出《漫威金刚狼》会让《漫威蜘蛛侠》的开发商Insomniac走向新的方向。到目前为止，游戏的发售前影像已经展现出这名经典漫画X战警成员格外血腥的一面，实机片段显示玩家可以撕碎任何挡路的喽啰。

paragraphs.en: Marvel's Wolverine has a September 15, 2026, release date for PS5. For more, you can read IGN's interview with Insomniac from June. You can also check out everything revealed in the game's "Ain't No Hero" trailer and why some fans filled up its comment sections .
paragraphs.cn: 《漫威金刚狼》将于2026年9月15日登陆PS5。想了解更多内容，可以阅读IGN于6月对Insomniac的采访，也可以查看游戏《Ain't No Hero》预告片公布的全部信息，以及部分粉丝为何在评论区刷屏。
